SoundHound has now completed the acquisition and is positioning itself as an omnichannel conversational AI platform spanning automotive, restaurants, customer service, healthcare and enterprise AI. Management's thesis is clear: combine Voice AI, Amelia, OASYS and LivePerson's customer base into a larger almost complete AI ecosystem. My bull case: accelerating AI adoption, cross-selling into LivePerson customers, larger enterprise footprint, and a stronger competitive position. Risk: integration execution, debt/dilution concerns, continued losses, and potential customer churn from the acquired business. At ~$6/share, the market seems focused entirely on the risks. If management executes, sentiment could look very different in 12-24 months.
